reading_note: The teaching describes how, from the inmost Divine, distinct goods and truths proceed in order — each from a discrete degree of the Divine mind (the five faculties). The arc moves from the inmost source (the Father), down through the discrete degrees (mind, life, teaching, counsel, reflection), each producing a corresponding form of received good or truth, until all stand "one beside another" as the ordered series in which the Divine reveals itself in heaven. The single arc: the Divine emanates Himself in distinguishable yet continuous degrees of love and wisdom, each lower born from the one above.
